about.text: A very firm, sour, slightly sweet yak cheese from northern Yunnan, near the Tibetan Autonomous Region. It is hung above the stove to take on smoke and brown with age, and eaten with tea and tsampa or in momos. Sources differ on whether it is a cheese or a dried curd.
